answer_1.quote: Both a generative Image Description task and a discriminative Visual Question Answering (VQA) task are designed. We evaluate the LVLMs on the Description task in terms of both recognition and cognition abilities.

answer_2.quote: We use METEOR, CIDEr, BLEU-1, BLEU-2 to evaluate the model performance on the Description task. Recognition Score and Cognition Score are also computed automatically.

answer_3.quote: For the Cognition Score, we calculate the scores for each of the eight cognitive reasoning dimensions, as well as an overall score using GPT-4.
methods: binary classification of CoR presence via GPT-4 prompts

answer_4.quote: Note that the accuracy of Human in Table is calculated based on the responses of five healthy people. The annotators are mostly undergraduate or graduate students aged 18-28.
answer_4.guideline: Human participants answered the VQA questions; accuracy was measured against the correct answers.
